text:
aisha: Heads-up — Lumina opened a dispute. They upgraded Dedicated tier on 2026-02-12 but the Feb invoice charged the full month at new price. They say we should've prorated or applied commit credits. Can we confirm treatment for month-end close?
mark: can you paste the invoice lines?
aisha: sure: ```
INV-2026-4097
2026-02-01 - 2026-02-28 Dedicated: 10 x v100 - $20,000
2026-02-12 upgrade adjustment: +$10,000
Credit applied: $0
```
jules: seems like we billed full month at upgraded rate instead of proration. If Lumina had legacy commit credits, need to check their contract effective date.
liam: for revrec, the portion of service applicable to the period after 2/12 should be recognized over the remaining commitment term. The overcharge portion should be a contra-revenue / credit note now. 
mark: agree. Accounting ops: create a deferral for the portion tied to future service and record an accrual for the expected credit if we plan to issue CN. Which period should this hit? Feb close or Mar? Need controller guidance.
aisha: Controller (cc @julia-legal) — recommend hitting Feb close with an adjusting JE to reclassify the overbilled amount to deferred revenue and record an accounts payable/credit accrual. This keeps revenue clean for Feb. Thoughts?
julia-legal: ok from contract review — upgrade effective 2/12 and SOW requires proration unless override. Legal supports issuing CN. No regulatory flags.
liam: operational note — credits > $5k need manager sign-off. Overbill amount ~ $6,200 estimated. @mark can you approve the credit?
mark: approved. Please create billing ticket and CN.
billing-bot: Created ticket BILL-7623 and credit note CN-2026-489 for $6,238.40.
aisha: thanks — finance ops, please post JE below and tag me when done. JE suggestion: DR Sales Rev $6,238.40 CR Deferred Rev $6,238.40 (Feb close), plus accrual to AP if CN not yet issued.
liam: will post JE in close checklist and route for approval. tagging ops to execute before EOD close. :thumbsup:
mark: add a short note in the monthly close deck so audit trail is clear.
aisha: will do.
